effigy.line: We burn these joints in effigy
stanza: I'd sing her classic country songs
And she'd get high and sing along
She don't have a voice to sing with now
We burn these joints in effigy
Cry about what we used to be
Try to ignore the elephant somehow

effigy.line: So when you come to burn an effigy
stanza: So when you come to burn an effigy
It should keep the flies away
And when you learn to burn this effigy
For the hours that slip away, slip away
